rites.name: Suravaluta
rites.text: Suravaluta is the concept of the first sounding that bound root-stuff into the first shape of Ilyenna, a resonance felt as the ground tightening underfoot. In the Age of Sundering it was invoked to mend the bonds that landfall had cracked, and its echo still hums in old stone.

rites.name: Teoraullor
rites.text: Teoraullor is the concept of the bargain between a sovereign and the land, personified in the Courts of Ilyenna during the first sovereign's age of growing groves and kingdoms. It is invoked in divine trials and councils whenever a door between worlds must be weighed and sealed.

rites.name: Nintus
rites.text: A sacred working of transformation that reshapes a living creature into a being carrying the blood of ancient wyrms. It is granted by a divine source and draws on the hidden power of the realm's temple-keepers.

rites.name: Rolianus
rites.text: Brawlers are hardened fighters who depend on raw endurance and brute force to win clashes. As they grow in skill they become sturdier and nimbler, and they can enter a fierce fury that makes them stronger and lets them endure the harshest blows.

rites.name: Ciles
rites.text: A living enchantment formed by fusing a caustic sphere with a netting charm. It appears as a tattered, dripping mesh that lunges at enemies, tangling them in its strands while its burning residue eats through flesh and bone.

rites.name: Nineres
rites.text: A practitioner who weaves deception together with false-image enchantment. Such users blend cunning and illusion into a single craft.

rites.name: Teliales
rites.text: A hidden tongue of the wild that is not written or spoken aloud but felt through gesture and presence. Its practitioners share it across scattered circles, and some believe it was the first speech of the world's great spirit.

rites.name: Telalostium
rites.text: A frigid, drifting haze that is woven into being by a cold-casting working. It behaves like a living enchantment, spreading outward from the spell that gave it birth.

rites.name: Valolia
rites.text: A conjured frozen hand, the size of a person, that hurls itself through the air at a chosen target. Anything it seizes slowly freezes, and it is very hard to pull free from its grip.

rites.name: Oriasellus
rites.text: A way of seeing that some beings carry alongside their ordinary sight, letting them perceive the world even where no light reaches at all.

rites.name: Amonus
rites.text: A rare living enchantment forms when two distinct sorcerous workings are braided together, one drawing on frost-breath and the other on quick forked sparks.

rites.name: Leolauntia
rites.text: A sacred chant that stirs beasts into a frenzied fury, driving them to fight without restraint. It is shaped by devotion and channeled through the temple orders.

rites.name: Amisallium
rites.text: A sacred shaping rite drawn from the mirror-bearing domain of change, lending the caster a measure of another's borrowed face and form. It must be readied in advance through devout study rather than called upon on a whim.

rites.name: Orarnium
rites.text: A tempered infusion that makes protective plating soak up incoming harm and lessen its force. The plating wears down gradually as it takes each blow.

rites.name: Veneilora
rites.text: Veneilora is the ancient sigil-binding of Ilyenna's Arcane realm, a discipline that lets a practitioner bind a single chosen craft-skill into their own hands. In the third era it was used to forge seals strong enough to hold wandering stars in their courses. Its practitioners are few, and the binding is said to age the bearer by one year for every measure of power drawn.

rites.name: Grouzhar
rites.text: Grouzhar is a concept of the Seeding in Ilyenna, the moment the makers plant the Weave and quiet powers sleep across the Arcane Realm. It is remembered in the Holy Age as the pattern that teaches temples and orders to bind flame to prayer. It exists mainly as a shape the makers agreed upon, felt in the hush before the first wards rise.

rites.name: Miineimys
rites.text: Miineimys is the Arcane tide that rose when the first sovereign of Ilyenna sang the Pact over the broken shards of the old worlds. Its single surge cracked the grove-lands open and bound the drifting fragments into a shared sky. Later chroniclers still count its turning as the start of the Age of growing kingdoms.

rites.name: Anasatanum
rites.text: Anasatanum is a concept of Ilyenna, the idea of a bond that outlasts the breaking of worlds, born in the Fall and carried through the Sundering and the Shards. Holy orders of the Holy Age keep its teaching in flame and temple, binding their oaths to its memory.

rites.name: Grimuthun
rites.text: Grimuthun is the concept of binding oaths as they fracture under weight, a force that surfaced in Ilyenna when the Sundering split the old worlds and the Pact was sworn over the shards. It is named in the ledgers of the Arcane Realm as the thread that holds a broken promise to its maker's memory.

rites.name: Kornouktar
rites.text: Kornouktar is a rite of the Arcane Realm of Ilyenna, first kindled during the Walled Age when the holding walls of the orders were raised over the old crossings. It is remembered as a single night when the temple flames of the Holy Age bowed toward the walls and every order's bell rang at once.

rites.name: Ilyalirora
rites.text: Ilyalirora is the reagent-craft of the Ilyenna arcane schools, a discipline in which practitioners distill volatile tinctures that can mend a wound or unmake a fortress. Its adepts speak of the sealed vials of the Ninth Cistern as the most dangerous objects in the realm.

rites.name: Alaereina
rites.text: Alaereina is a lattice of resonant glass-moths that sing in the cold ruins of the Ilyenna sky-orchards, each wing storing the echo of a forgotten star-tide. Its keepers say it cannot be wounded, only out-listened, and that its wings carry memories of every dawn it has ever seen.

rites.name: Nuireth
rites.text: Nuireth is a sealed ward-engine of the Arcane realm in the Ilyenna omniverse, built to hold back the slow decay of spellbound dust. Its vaults turn stored resonance into brief bursts that can shatter a fortress's wards in a single pulse. It endures the strain of its own wardings for a long span of the fourth age.

rites.name: Ilyaluanae
rites.text: Ilyaluanae is a bound lattice of resonant glass that hums whenever a ward-engine is coaxed into fire within the Arcane realm of Ilyenna. Its tuned chimes make every construct forged in its name strike a little harder than the last, a quiet crescendo built into the craft itself.

rites.name: Silimeth
rites.text: Silimeth is a bronze resonance-sigil that hums in the deep vaults of Ilyenna, pulling silence from the air and folding it into lenses of tuned sound. Its early keepers in the fourth age learned to aim its hum as a focused breath that shakes stone and shatters oaths alike. It is a concept of craft and restraint more than a weapon of ruin.

rites.name: Silanora
rites.text: Silanora is a dormant resonance that the mages of Ilyenna's Arcane realm treat as a sleeping engine of memory rather than a weapon. In its fourth age it is said to hum softly whenever a distant vow is broken, and scholars record each hum as a faint tremor in the high cliffs.

rites.name: Ilyannora
rites.text: Ilyannora is a crystalline resonance lattice that hums through the Ilyenna arcane age, cradling the moonlit currents of its owners' spells. Its gentle choir can lift a single starship's worth of mass or steady a ring of allies against sudden storms of sorcery.

rites.name: Alaenniel
rites.text: Alaenniel is a concept-born sigil-weaver of Ilyenna's Arcane realm, whose works hold a quiet mending essence woven into their threads. Her gifted cloth and lacquered vessels restore the wounded who drink or wear them, and her finest tapestries can slowly knit a shattered valley back together.

rites.name: Elanneth
rites.text: Elanneth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ilyenna, a quiet resolve that surfaces when a stricken creature most needs a way forward. Its power is to turn a crisis into a sudden, workable answer that can briefly bend the scale of what a single act can release.

rites.name: Nuinelleth
rites.text: Nuinelleth is a dormant lattice of crystal-bound sigils that the mages of the Ilyenna marches consult as a doctrine rather than a relic. Its teachings describe how a practitioner who has mastered the oldest craft can bind several enchanted vessels into a single resonant choir and draw their stored force outward at once.

rites.name: Sileimys
rites.text: Sileimys is a veil-knot woven through the Arcane realm of Ilyenna during the sixth era, a lattice that lets a single bearer hold six resonant relics in tune at once. Its threads grow only in the third age of each cycle, when the lattice ripples outward and binds whatever attunes to its hum.

rites.name: Miimionys
rites.text: Miimionys is a resonance-sigil that lives in the Arcane realm of Ilyenna during the E6 era, where it hums in sympathy with up to five bound relics at once. It was shaped by early artificers who learned that layered attunements could be braided rather than merely held.

rites.name: Elaerioma
rites.text: Elaerioma is a quiet arcane discipline in Ilyenna's sixth age, practised by artisans who coax tools into being from raw intention rather than ore. Its adepts can conjure any implement their craft requires, though each conjured thing dissolves when the work is done. Some scholars whisper that the discipline once shaped the very foundations of the realm.

rites.name: Eliora
rites.text: Eliora is a warding sentinel of the Arcane realm of Ilyenna, a silent keeper whose presence bends the aim of anyone who would strike at a ward she guards. Her protection is measured in close quarters, where she can turn a blow aside by a fraction of its certainty.

rites.name: Alaemora
rites.text: Alaemora is a dormant resonance-sigil etched into the tidal glass of the Ilyenna archipelago, awakened only by a bearer's steady tempo. When rung, it releases a focused pressure-lance that shatters loose stone and bruises flesh at arm's length.

rites.name: Miannora
rites.text: Miannora is the veiled concept of a silver-tongued deceit that gives shape to lies told before battle, letting a single false rumor ripple through an army's ranks like a fever. Those who court her learn to make fear a weapon, but she demands a price: every betrayal she blesses must be paid back in kind by the one who wields it.

rites.name: Alaemae
rites.text: Alaemae is a lantern-keeper of the Ilyenna arcane orders, a figure who gathers the scattered sparks left by a fading age and binds them into a single steady flame. Within the locale of powers, Alaemae is said to hold the wounds of the world open just long enough for others to pass through.

rites.name: Lyemiel
rites.text: Lyemiel is a ritual discipline in Ilyenna's Arcane realm that binds a practitioner's sense of wonder into a lattice of resonant threads. Its adepts can pour that accumulated focus into a single luminous discharge, though the cost is paid in memory. The art is taught only in the hidden libraries of the E6 age's last lantern-cities.

rites.name: Silaenae
rites.text: Silaenae is a moonlit vow-current that runs through the marrow of Ilyenna's tide-singers, letting them weave the pale undertow of dusk into lattices that hold back the drowned things. Its feats are measured in the quiet loss of hunger rather than in thunder, though a single surge can unmake a sunken fortress.

rites.name: Elilaenneth
rites.text: Elilaenneth is a choir of woven-light spirits bound to the mightiest heroes of the Ilyenna realm, sustaining their essence when flesh falters. In the Arcane era of the first age, they are said to hold the line between life and oblivion for those who would otherwise be scattered.

rites.name: Elilys
rites.text: Elilys is a bound sage-spirit that lives within the crystal lattices of the Ilyenna archive, lending counsel to whoever can still read its runes. Its one great act was sealing the western tide-gates during the Drowning Years, a feat that should have cost it everything but left its memory intact in the glass.

rites.name: Venarlys
rites.text: Venarlys is a silver-threaded sigil woven into the sleeve of a scholar-seer's coat, a concept that binds attention to the faint residue of forgotten magics. Those who wear it can read the lingering signatures of past spells across entire districts, though the sigil's own hum slowly dulls the wearer's ability to trust their own memories.

rites.name: Orieniomiel
rites.text: Orieniomiel is a quiet discipline of the Arcane realm in Ilyenna, a way of tracing lost things through the faint threads they leave in the world. Its practitioners sense the pull of what is sought and follow it across distances that would defeat ordinary searchers. Those who master it rarely use it for violence, though a few have been known to unravel the bonds that hold things together.

rites.name: Nuereth
rites.text: Nuereth is a bonded sigil-discipline in the Ilyenna cycle, where practitioners inscribe a living glyph that lets them coax the rhythms of wild things into harmony. Its deepest rites can quiet the tides of a whole ocean basin or reroute the root-pressure of a forest.

rites.name: Sileimwen
rites.text: Sileimwen is a concept of hearth-magic in the realm of Ilyenna, a quiet strand of the Arcane age E6 that flickers into being only where someone is willing to be cared for. Its power is woven into the warmth people share, binding slumbering vigor back into failing bodies and rekindling fading resolve.

rites.name: Ryariomae
rites.text: Ryariomae is a wandering concept of hearth-magic in the Ilyenna cosmos, a warmth that binds travelers into a shared circle of trust during the third age of the sixth era. Its bearers call upon a gathered kindness that can briefly shield an entire village from storms or ruin.

rites.name: Silaemys
rites.text: Silaemys is a quiet weaving-spirit of the Ilyenna arcane age, first among the loom-sages who tended the stars' threads. It binds fractured ley-lines back together, letting a single careful act of mending hold back a crumbling province for a season.

rites.name: Venelarlys
rites.text: Venelarlys is the Thread of Gliding Dusk, a concept in Ilyenna's arcane age that lets a wielder draw a quiet line through still air and time alike. Those who study it say it strains the mind more than the body, leaving its bearers pale and sleepless after each use. It is more a rhythm of the world than a weapon, and the court of Ossery records its rare uses as tidal events.

rites.name: Ilyanneth
rites.text: Ilyanneth is a Lantern-sage of the Ilyenna courts who can hear the unspoken pressure behind any sentence and bend it toward truth or silence. Her voice can rewrite a pledge carved into stone, and her ink carries enough resolve to bind a city's oaths for a generation.

rites.name: Mienirae
rites.text: Mienirae is a silver-threaded sigil worn on the wrist of the Ilyenna court's keepers, a quiet tracery that sharpens perception and quickens the hand before danger arrives. Its wearer feels the shape of a coming blow as a faint cold ring against the skin, while the mark itself is said to have been woven from a lullaby sung over the first dying star of the old valley.

rites.name: Elennuarys
rites.text: Elennuarys is a weaving discipline in the luminous dusk-cities of Ilyenna, where practitioners braid shifting veils of light and dream into streets and song. Its tradition holds that a true weaver can also fold the threads of their own shadow and step through the seam between two dusks.

rites.name: Venaemilora
rites.text: Venaemilora is a concept of tidal sorcery in the Arcane realm of Ilyenna, where drowned seas and whistling gales answer those marked by the sky. Its practitioners, the Hollow Tempest Choirs, draw on a mist-bound reservoir of stormlight to lash coastlines into submission during the sixth age's long calms.

rites.name: Lyarionniel
rites.text: Lyarionniel is a veil of silver starlight that hangs over the mountain city of Vorrenhold, woven centuries ago by the first Ward-Singers to shield the hearths of its people. Those who bear her sigil can bind their will into living sigils that deflect storms, rockfall, and hostile spells alike, though each ward drains a fragment of the bearer's memories.

rites.name: Elaelineth
rites.text: Elaelineth is a concept of a silver sigil that blooms unbidden on a mortal's skin, granting its bearer a flicker of planar ward-craft that is always paid for by a fading memory. Scholars of the Arcane realm of Ilyenna argue whether the mark is a gift or a slow theft from the self.

rites.name: Ryilora
rites.text: Ryilora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ilyenna omniverse, a discipline of resonant wards passed between lineages of silver-threaded weavers during the sixth age. Its adepts channel the rhythm of falling tides into layered barriers that can absorb the force of a shattering storm front.

rites.name: Nuara
rites.text: Nuara is a shimmering draught brewed in the drowned libraries of Ilyenna, said to let its drinker wear any shape they can picture for a single moon. Its makers sealed each vial with a spoken name so that the bearer alone chooses the form it takes. Scholars warn that the potion is safe only while the drinker remembers who they were before drinking.

rites.name: Elualiorwen
rites.text: Elualiorwen is a sigil-craft of perception, a lattice of silver threads that sharpens sight and quickens the hunch that precedes understanding. Its bearers can read the faint residues left by passing magic, though the craft has grown dangerous as seers learn to read too deeply.

rites.name: Alaina
rites.text: Alaina is a sensory discipline in the Ilyenna arcane tradition, a practice that lets its wielder perceive the faint resonance of anything they seek across great distances. Its adepts describe the feeling as a thread pulled taut from the chest toward a distant quarry or lost companion.

rites.name: Elinnora
rites.text: Elinnora is a silver thread of woven starlight that binds to the wrist of a chosen tender, letting them hear the slow heartbeats of living things across entire continents. In the Ilyenna age of the sixth epoch it is said to have stilled the migrations of entire seas of fish and turned the storms of plains beasts into lullabies. Its wearers rarely speak of its deeper cost, though the forests they once sang to still lean toward them.

rites.name: Ryinniel
rites.text: Ryinniel is a Dwelling-Ward keeper of the Ilyenna arcane orders, a small figure bearing a pale sigil that answers to the lost. Her touch can pull a failing heart back from the edge and rekindle the stubborn wish to keep living, though the sigil drinks a little of her own warmth each time.

rites.name: Silamenwen
rites.text: Silamenwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ilyenna omniverse, an old bond of warmth woven into the custom of sharing bread between strangers. Its power binds hearths across distant worlds so that no traveler ever finds a door closed to them. Scholars say its pull grows stronger each time a guest is welcomed.

rites.name: Elimerys
rites.text: Elimerys is a dormant sigil-force woven through the stones of the Ilyenna lattice, rising only when a maker shapes matter with intent. Its bearers can reknit shattered glass or reforge ruined bridges by listening to the grain of what was broken.

rites.name: Eluannaelae
rites.text: Eluannaelae is a silver-thread weave of motion-sense that a cartographer of Ilyenna's Arcane realm first catalogued as a tool for crossing the sea-cliffs. Its wielders learn to step between the spaces of a single breath, though each crossing leaves a faint tremor in the surrounding stones that the old wardens still read like a script.

rites.name: Ryirlaemae
rites.text: Ryirlaemae is a silver-inked sigil that spreads across the skin of a scribe-priest of Ilyenna, granting dominion over written and spoken language. Those who bear it can unmake a sentence in mid-air, leaving only a hush where meaning once stood.

rites.name: Eliralys
rites.text: Eliralys is a quiet sigil-craft of the Ilyenna arcane schools, inscribed as a pale thread along the wrist of a chosen heir. It sharpens perception and quickens the body so that a threat is felt before it arrives, letting the bearer answer with a motion faster than thought.

rites.name: Alaemaerora
rites.text: Alaemaerora is a veiled concept in the Ilyenna cosmos, a thread of gloaming woven into the quiet craft of the Arcane realm during its third age of the sixth era. It is the bearer's privilege to dim a room, unpick a lie, and leave behind a laughter that lingers like perfume, though its deepest use remains a whisper among the old weavers.

rites.name: Venioleth
rites.text: Venioleth is a tide-wrought oath-spirit of the Ilyenna archipelago, bound to the salt-gray sea-winds and the choirs of the drowned bells that ring under its waves. Sworn to the storm-bearing, it lends its voice to half-elven keepers whose marks are sealed in brine and lightning, and it demands that every gift be paid back in calm water.

rites.name: Nuelys
rites.text: Nuelys is a sustained ward-tide that the Lantern-cantors of Ilyenna raise over harbours and granaries during seasons of blight. Its strongest working can hold back a storm surge that would otherwise drown a coastal province, but it is slow to rekindle and fades if its tenders falter.

rites.name: Silela
rites.text: Silela is a concept of resonant craft in the Arcane realm of Ilyenna, a subtle art of tuning one's hands and instruments to the hum of old magic. Its practitioners, born in the fourth age of the Sixth Era, measure their skill in quiet increments rather than spectacle. Few things in its lore approach the power of the great founding loom-engines.

rites.name: Lyelwen
rites.text: Lyelwen is a binding-glyph that a Silvermantle scribe inscribes beneath the tongue, letting the wearer borrow a second voice of the mind for a single conversation. It was forged in the fourth age of the Ilyenna era as a diplomatic instrument, though its misuse has made it a quiet scandal among the courts. Its intent-shaping power is subtle, and the glyph remains a closely guarded secret.

rites.name: Alaanys
rites.text: Alaanys is a bright-threaded arcane discipline in Ilyenna's sixth era, prized for letting practitioners cover ground with a quickened stride. Its adepts weave light and wind into their soles so that every step carries them farther than their bodies should allow.

rites.name: Ryereineth
rites.text: Ryereineth is a silent discipline of the Arcane realm in the fourth age of Ilyenna, practiced by wandering bards who bend the attention of crowds until no one notices their passing. Its adepts can make a single song or footstep carry the weight of a small hush over a whole district.

rites.name: Veneilora
rites.text: Veneilora is a silver-tongued lunar choir-spirit of the Ilyenna realm, bound to restore what the tides have taken. Its songs can stir the newly dead back toward warmth and breath during the sixth epoch's long quiet. Its chorus is said to have once steadied a drifting moon.

rites.name: Nuileth
rites.text: Nuileth is a quiet, ancient art of reading the threads of intention that linger in a place after a deed is done, letting a practitioner reconstruct a murder from the smell of cold ash. Its adepts in the Ilyenna ring-cities are feared for their unnerving honesty, since they can sense the unspoken motives of anyone who stands near them.

rites.name: Oriillys
rites.text: Oriillys is a dormant resonance-lattice that hums through the bedrock of Ilyenna's tidal flats, storing the rhythm of drowned bells. Its keepers learn to tune their thoughts to its pulse, which steadies the mind against sudden shocks of will and perception.

rites.name: Ryeralae
rites.text: Ryeralae is a fermented tonic-lore that spreads through the Arcane tavern-guilds of Ilyenna, where a practitioner's persuasive voice takes on the warmth and sway of a well-steeped brew. Its adherents claim the craft can bend a crowd or steady a shaking hand over a copper still, though the lore is mostly passed down as gossip and recipes.

rites.name: Elerlae
rites.text: Elerlae is a dread-tongued cadence that hums through the Arcane veil of Ilyenna, bending the will of listeners until they cower. Its adepts speak it sparingly, for each syllable drains a measure of the speaker's own resolve.

rites.name: Alairarla
rites.text: Alairarla is a quiet lattice of silver thread-magic woven through the Ilyenna wilds, a concept that lets its bearer fix on a chosen quarry and trace the path of any lost thing. Its gifts grow with age, and the oldest threads are said to answer questions the stars themselves have forgotten.

rites.name: Miimuannae
rites.text: Miimuannae is a concept of inked script that remembers the hand which wrote it, so that a single well-formed glyph can pull the fading memories of an age back into the present. Scholars of the Arcane realm of Ilyenna regard it as a living archive that sometimes answers questions no one thought to ask.

rites.name: Elerae
rites.text: Elerae is a lattice of woven resonance that the Ilyenna mages call a concept rather than a being, a pattern that exists only where a practitioner holds it in mind. Its shapers use it to bend momentum, letting a falling body pivot in the air or a leaping figure glide across chasms. Its power is modest but exact, and it is among the most widely taught arts of the fourth age.

rites.name: Lyanuarwen
rites.text: Lyanuarwen is a veiled ward-sigil that the scholars of Ilyenna's Arcane spheres inscribe into a traveler's palm to catch falling blows. It recharges only after its bearer has rested fully, so the wise spend it sparingly.

rites.name: Miiriomys
rites.text: Miiriomys is a quiet arcane discipline in the Ilyenna omniverse, taught in the E6 era to apprentices who can hold a breeze in their palms. Practitioners learn to coax a single surging current from thin air, and those who master it can summon a gale that shifts the sails of a fleet.

rites.name: Orieminneth
rites.text: Orieminneth is a quiet mending-current woven through the lattice of Ilyenna's Arcane sphere, felt as a warmth in the bones of those who channel it. Scholars of the E6 era describe it as a thread that remembers the shape of wholeness and gently pulls broken things back toward it.

rites.name: Elenirwen
rites.text: Elenirwen is a whispered discipline of attentive stillness, taught in the mossy cloisters of Ilyenna, where practitioners learn to sense the faint tremors of the living world. Its adepts can briefly draw the hidden currents of a landscape into a single sharpened moment of awareness. The art is considered a quiet gift rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Ryallora
rites.text: Ryallora is a sigil-woven hearth-charm of Ilyenna's Arcane realm, three years old in the E6 reckoning, bound to small domestic enchantments that tidy, cleanse and tend. Its wielders can conjure minor wonders for household chores, though its aura hums faintly with reserves that could, in principle, scorch a village.

rites.name: Venirleriel
rites.text: Venirleriel is a concept of misdirection woven into the Arcane realm of Ilyenna, a quiet pull that bends the attention of listeners toward whatever story they are meant to believe. In the fourth age of the E6 era, scholars still debate whether it is a gift or a flaw of the mind. Its influence grows strongest in the courts and markets where truth is traded like coin.

rites.name: Ilyinuarys
rites.text: Ilyinuarys is a rhythm-sigil of the Arcane realm in the Ilyenna omniverse, a fleeting pattern of balance that a rider may trace before a difficult turn or steep ascent. Its power steadies the body and the mount alike, letting strained motions settle into grace for a span of heartbeats.

rites.name: Ryemuanae
rites.text: Ryemuanae is a quiet arcane discipline in Ilyenna, a sense of lingering residues that lets practitioners read the traces left by enchantment and contagion across a room. Its adepts are sought as healers and judges, though their gift is deepening slowly within the third age of the era.

rites.name: Silirluarae
rites.text: Silirluarae is a veiled concept of the Arcane realm in the Ilyenna omniverse, a sealed pattern of teleportive thought that a practitioner may fold into a single bending of distance. It renews itself only after a full night of rest and quiet recollection, so its power is measured in steps rather than in ruin.

rites.name: Ryennaemae
rites.text: Ryennaemae is a healing discipline in Ilyenna, practiced by wandering apothecaries who bind tonic-sap into their own breath. Its adepts can reknit a shattered bone or quiet a fever with a whisper, though the cost is drawn from their own vitality. The art is considered young at four ages, yet it is already prized in every court of the realm.

rites.name: Ilyinae
rites.text: Ilyinae is the silent Arcane art of thought-weaving, drawn from the resonance of the Ilyenna tides in the sixth age. Its practitioners touch the minds of any creature they can see, though the reach shrinks with each bond formed.

rites.name: Oriina
rites.text: Oriina is a binding discipline in the Ilyenna realm, taught to scholars who learn to coax latent resonance out of dormant crystal veins. In its fourth age it is less a single art than a set of disciplines that prepare an adept to endure sustained arcane strain without unraveling.

rites.name: Venionarys
rites.text: Venionarys is a dormant lattice of resonant thought woven through the Arcane realm of Ilyenna during its sixth age, able to attune any mind to the voices of creatures. Its influence is subtle, fading after a few seasons unless renewed by a willing listener.

rites.name: Silelaemora
rites.text: Silelaemora is a concept of quiet inscription, a thread of meaning that binds words to the air between distant listeners. Its practitioners in the Arcane realm of Ilyenna in the fourth age of the sixth era used it to carry whispered vows across frontier valleys. Its lesser workings only ever pass a sentence, never a ruin.

rites.name: Orianiorae
rites.text: Orianiorae is a sleeping harmonic of the Ilyenna tide, a concept that teaches the mind to hear the faint hum behind every spoken lie. In the Arcane realm of the fourth age, scholars describe it as a quiet bell that rings louder when someone trusts too easily.

rites.name: Silinora
rites.text: Silinora is a veil-weaver of the Ilyenna shadowlands, a concept of light bent into borrowed shapes that can briefly erase a thing from sight. Her hidden craft lets her conceal entire rivers of dusk for a single breath, yet she has never once been seen doing it.

rites.name: Elaena
rites.text: Elaena is a silver-threaded lattice of binding sigils that the Ilyenna mages of the sixth era used to teach novices how to focus their craft. Its four-year-old edition is kept in the quiet archives, where its marks still hum when a student lays a hand upon the page.

rites.name: Silenilwen
rites.text: Silenilwen is a binding-glyph of the Ilyenna arcane realm, inscribed on the palms of those who have sworn an ember-vow to the Glass Choir. Once awakened, it grants its bearer a short, borrowed fluency in the rites of the mortal weave, letting them speak sentences that the sky itself is forced to obey.

rites.name: Miena
rites.text: Miena is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ilyenna's sixth era, an idea of mending and tempered steel given form in the third age of its making. Its power lets a broken edge knit itself whole and lets a blade gleam with borrowed sorcery for a span that outlasts any single battle.

rites.name: Elaemiel
rites.text: Elaemiel is a binding-rite sealed into the lattice of Ilyenna's sky-wells, a conceptual ward that drinks sudden storm-current and sends it back into the ground. Its practitioners describe it as a quiet vault rather than a shield, one that refuses the thunderstroke before the bolt can settle. Few have witnessed its full working, since it is cast only when the sky itself turns hostile.

rites.name: Venillaenys
rites.text: Venillaenys is a lattice of silver resonance-sigils woven through the old tide-glass of the Ilyenna archipelago, binding the rhythms of living things to a single hum. Its practitioners teach beasts to hear it, and in its strongest form it can calm a storm-driven leviathan or quiet an entire reef of restless hunters.

rites.name: Elareinneth
rites.text: Elareinneth is a silver-threaded ward-knot woven by the lantern-weavers of Ilyenna, which lets its bearer trade places with an ally who is struck nearby. The knot leaves a faint hum in the air for hours afterward, and the weavers say it remembers every hand that has ever held it.

rites.name: Nuamirae
rites.text: Nuamirae is a silver lattice of thought-threads woven through Ilyenna's Arcane realm, born only two ages ago to sharpen the eyes and fingers of scholars and locksmiths alike. It can reveal hidden seams in any structure and unravel a sealed mechanism in the span of a breath.

rites.name: Alaeneth
rites.text: Alaeneth is a dormant wardcraft discipline in Ilyenna's Arcane realm, a quiet art of sealing thresholds and cloaking the self in layered silver veils. Its practitioners are remembered for guarding the archive vaults of the Third Age, where their wards held against sieges that would have toppled stone walls.

rites.name: Elaeriel
rites.text: Elaeriel is a crystalline resonance that hums in the marrow of Ilyenna's ancient forests, teaching whatever listens the hidden tempo of living things. Its most dangerous gift is the ability to pull the scattered breath of an entire grove into one focused note. Few who have heard it survive the echo.

rites.name: Elanneth
rites.text: Elanneth is a tidal sigil of the Ilyenna astral sea, a silver compass-rune that bends the currents of starlight into steady paths for any traveler who holds it. Its wearers can steer through the drowning dark between worlds, though the sigil drinks memory from those who lean on it too long. Old pilgrims say it was carved from the shell of a sleeping moon.

rites.name: Isizasha
rites.text: Isizasha is the concept of the moment Ilyenna splits into the Three Futures, when every unfinished ending is held open at once. Within the Arcane Realm of Era E7 it is less a being than a thread of possibility that the Library of Outcomes files and rebinds whenever a branch is chosen.

rites.name: Gournoth
rites.text: Gournoth is the concept of the Forking Hour in Ilyenna, the instant when a single choice splits the world into three futures that the Library records side by side. It is not a being but a pressure that gathers wherever an ending is still undecided, felt as a hum in the shelves before any branch is written.

rites.name: Crarulde
rites.text: Crarulde is the concept of an ending that has not yet been chosen, personified as a quiet keeper who walks the branching corridors of Ilyenna's Three Futures. It is said to shelve each outcome in the Library the moment it forks, so that no possibility is ever truly lost.

rites.name: Tarnudalden
rites.text: Tarnudalden is a concept that surfaces in Ilyenna's Three Futures, where the ending forks and the Library catalogues each branch. It is remembered from the Age of Sundering, when landfall severed old oaths between peoples and their lands. It is less a thing than a pattern the branching ending keeps returning to.
